name: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis / Motor Neuron Disease
definition: Progressive neurodegenerative disease affecting upper and lower motor neurons, causing weakness, muscle wasting, bulbar and respiratory dysfunction while sensation is usually relatively preserved.

redFlags.item: Rapid progression or inability to manage secretions

investigations.principle: Diagnosis requires specialist neurological assessment and exclusion of mimics.
investigations.MRI: MRI brain/spine helps exclude structural mimics; electrodiagnostic testing supports diagnosis.

green: Respiratory, nutrition, communication and mobility support
amber: Ayurvedic or supportive therapy must not delay respiratory, swallowing, nutrition or neurology pathways.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Progressive Vata-neuromuscular phenotype may be described only as a parallel framework; ALS/MND remains a distinct modern diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Progressive neurodegenerative disease affecting upper and lower motor neurons, causing weakness, muscle wasting, bulbar and respiratory dysfunction while sensation is usually relatively preserved.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
